set a to 1 + ¬
	2
set b to ¬
	"x"
set c to {1, ¬
	2, 3}
display dialog ¬
	"hi" buttons {"OK"}
set d to length ¬
	of "abc"
if a > 0 and ¬
	b = "x" then set e to 1
display dialog "a" buttons {"OK"} ¬
	default button 1
tell application "Finder" to ¬
	activate
if true then ¬
	beep
set x to {1 ¬
	, 2}
set y to "a" & ¬
	"b" & ¬
	"c"
set z to (1 + ¬
	(2 * ¬
		3))
